description: Postcodes not on the gas network is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. This spreadsheet contains a list of postcodes where Xoserve holds no record of a gas connection by either large or small gas transporters. This data was produced using Xoserve's list of off-gas postcodes, which is available at Xoserve's data shows all postcodes which do NOT have any gas connection, domestic or non-domestic. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
